_comment: Registry of what the user's own use of the vault produces. An update never writes into, replaces or deletes these paths. A kit tool that writes at use time must be listed under writers (tools/test_update_survival.py in the build fails otherwise): register where it writes, and put any new per-user file under claude-kit/state via tools/kit_state.py.

user_state.what: hiccup ledger, games ledger, share setting, personal preventions
thumbnail variant results ledger (results.jsonl), sharing setting, queued marker
local-rules.md: your own rules, read by the hiccup pre-flight
vault files you edited that an update kept
the incoming versions (.vault-new) of those files
copies taken before anything of yours is replaced (newest 10 dated folders)
which project copies the mode made; copies you edited are kept
gate, verdict, scorecard, benchmark history and status files of a game
your games (README.md resume file per game) and research: never touched by load, unload, sync or update
hooks are merged only on --with-hooks and backed up; your own skills/agents are never in the manifest

install.sh.writes: claude-kit/ (installed files, installed.tsv, state/conflicts), never state/ data

tools/kit-install-files.py.writes: installed files; keeps edited ones; state/conflicts*, installed.tsv (atomic), backup/

tools/kit-rename.py.writes: one-time rename migration: moves unchanged old-named files to backup/, keeps edited ones

tools/kit-conflicts.py.writes: state/conflicts*, accept/keep: the file you chose, backup/, installed.tsv

tools/thumb_record.py.writes: state/thumbnails (results.jsonl, settings.json, queued.json); queued notes into state/learnings-queue/pending when sharing is on

tools/vault-mode.py.writes: <project>/.claude copies and vault-mode.json; claude-kit/vault-mode/loaded.json, layout.json; state/conflicts for edited project copies

tools/curate.py.writes: owner side: <vault>/learned and the vault-learnings clone given by --repo/--vault

tools/games.py.writes: <project>/Games (the loaded project folder; legacy <vault>/Games if it exists) and the --project folder

tools/vault-shards.py.writes: extra repository shards inside the folders their mount lists

tools/mentor-hook.py.writes: settings.json hook entry on --with-hooks only (backup first)

tools/skillpack.py.writes: catalogue file in the kit, only with --write (maintainer)

skills/rbx-uninstall/scripts/uninstall.p.writes: removes the kit after a plan, a yes and a backup of your files to ~/Roblox Games

skills/rbx-bench/scripts/*.writes: --out / game benchmark folders, history CSV given by the caller

skills/rbx-research/scripts/*.writes: the research output folder (default My Research)

skills/rbx-thumbnail/scripts/*.writes: --out folder; <game>/thumb-score (thumb_score.py gate record); <project>/renders (blender_gfx.py scripts, PNGs, sidecars)

skills/rbx-manager/presets/*.writes: copies agent presets to the folder given

systems/*.writes: check.py writes only into a temp folder

skillpack/*.writes: each script writes only the file or folder its arguments name (project/game files); none touches the config dir
